meta.description: Consult Dr Vishnu Gupta, Consultant Physician — General Medicine at R N Multispeciality Hospital Jaipur. 10+ years of experience. Book an appointment today.

biography: Dr Vishnu Gupta cares for adults across the common and chronic conditions of everyday health, including diabetes, thyroid disorders, blood pressure, respiratory and gastric problems, migraine and seasonal illness. Patients value his careful diagnosis, personalised treatment plans and the time he gives to listening.
clinicalPhilosophy: Every patient deserves compassionate care, clear communication, and the most effective, least invasive treatment plan available.
